semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical flow control components and environmental stress systems used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shenzhen Blue Dynamics Precision Co., Ltd. manufactures mass flow controllers and environmental stress systems for semiconductor processes such as CVD, PVD, etching, and ashing. Their products are designed for high precision and reliability, catering to the demanding requirements of semiconductor equipment.
capabilities: GT-2000 Series mass flow controllers for high precision and fast response
PC-1000 Series mass flow controllers with low internal leakage
TARGETS-2/3/4 Series customizable channel support systems
Environmental stress systems managing temperature, humidity, and pressure
